name: EPIC 248831438
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 10.7 solar radii and 1.78 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,171 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.78 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,158 K at its surface.
